reviews.text: I brought my dog Roxy in for a simple nail trim. She is about 100 lbs, and obviously nervous. So they decide to try and pick her up and put her on a table. We'll he dropped her. He dropped my large dog on her back btw, and continued with out even an apology  from anyone. And after all that they rushed the trimming with sub par results. My dog has hip issues, I guess ill be trimming myself since they don't know how to handle larger dogs

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ BEST DOG GROOMER EVER! 🐾✂️❤️

If I could give Terry 10 stars, I WOULD! 🌟 Terry is not only a wonderful family friend, but an UH-MAZING groomer who truly loves and cares for every fur baby like they’re her own. 🐶💕

Her patience, attention to detail, kindness, and talent are unmatched. Our pups always come home looking absolutely adorable, smelling fantastic, and most importantly—happy and loved! 🥰🐾

When you find someone you completely trust with your fur babies, you hold onto them—and Terry is THAT person for us!

We love you, Terry, and appreciate everything you do! ❤️🐕✂️ Hands down, the BEST! HIGHLY RECOMMEND! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
The best groomer ever! Everyone is so nice and accommodating with our anxious girl and they do such a good job. I always love the bandanas too!

This place is absolutely amazing. They do such a great job and are always accommodating. My dog journey has been going here since we moved to North Phoenix on a whim because I needed her to be groomed in a hurry they got her in 2 days later. She seems to love going there and they say she is well behaved. But she always comes out looking amazing we always get compliments. Thank you guys for being so great.
Best place ever to have your pet groomed.  Terry , the owner, has a great passion for your pet as do all the employees there. You do need to make an appointment though, walk ins ok for nail clipping.
Friendly professional service great attention to details wouldn’t go anywhere else
They did an amazing job on my pups! Two hours vs. four at other groomers.

The staff here asked lots of questions before beginning to care for my dog.  I felt that we were well respected and that my dog would be well cared for.  They called us in a reasonably quick time, and we're priced very reasonably.  Our dog looks great, and she is happy with herself!
Owner has been grooming for 36 years and been in business for 22 years.  Great staff, love of dogs and they cater to all dog needs.  Complete groomings at affordable prices.
Always fantastic service for our two puppies! Friendly and efficient! HIGHLY recommend!

I am very proud we found this pet groomer. Have been taking our little guy for just over 2 years now, and every time we are so happy how well he looks when we pick him up. We have a Yorkiepoo and Crystal takes such good care of him.
Awesome Groomers... My dog is very happy After Grooming.

i took my 5 month old yorkie here for his first real grooming experience and at first was very anxious brining him to a groomer in general, i am so glad i picked Hot dogs and Cool Cats, it went so so great! everyone working was so kind and was very helpful when i had questions about my dogs hair, they were able to help my puppy get all of his matting out, while keeping him cute, and sent him home very happy! i could not have imagined a better first experience!

The owner Terry is a loose canon. My dog came home with a bloody tongue that was bleeding all day. Clearly she grabbed my dog by the mouth to stop her from crying and her teeth cut her tongue..it was a deep cut.. Also had cut marks all over her from shaving her.. she acts all nice to you and abuses your dog…BEWARE!!!
Best groomer I have ever had.  My pup loves them.  Highly recommended!!!
Best experience I’ve had with a groomer. They take their time and do it right! I can’t imagine taking my long haired german shepherd/malamute mix anywhere else.

My dog was scruffy and scared when I brought her in, and when they were done with her her tail was wagging and she looked beautiful. Absolutely will be back. Excellent service, kind, and honestly they should charge more for the amount they do and they care they take.
They took great care of my little old man. Amazing price for amazing service. The owner was very nice and friendly as well as all the staff inside. Thank you!!!
Best dog groomer ever
Very friendly staff. Takes Very good care of my fur babies. Always does an amazing job.

Have been going to them for quite some time now. And they are always accommodating, kind, and helpful! Plus, my dog always comes back nice and clean!!!!

Their facility is neat and clean as well. I drive 30 mins to bring my dog here and wont go anywhere else.

I’ve been taking my doodle to groomers for 5 years. He goes 2-3 times a year as I maintain at home. These ladies are the BEST he has been to. And he loves going there to get his hair done!! It’s hard to find a groomer that likes and even takes doodles but you can really tell they love doodles, and dogs in general, right when you walk in. I’m moving out of state soon and will be sad to not have them anymore.
She did an awesome job with the challenges of having big fluffy dogs. They look amazing! Thank you!
Definitely a fantastic, safe and easy spot to take your pups for a cut. So glad to have found them!!
Such an awesome groomers!! Made my little poodle such a handsome little man. And such a good vibe in there as well!

Idk who here made this gentleman look so darn good! but a huge thank you!!!!!

I had lost all hope. Every time I took him anywhere they made him look so ugly, which is why I had given up and he was rocking the long hair for so long.

Found this place, and was able to take him the same day, and he looks amazing! SO THANK YOU!
Would definitely recommend. They did a great job with my girl Bella, she’s so happy now. I’ll definitely be returning.

Amazing place to take your dog for a spa day! The owner, Terry, is so kind and very skilled at grooming. All her groomers are highly skilled and treat my dog very well. I love how consistent they are with their full grooms and how organized they are with keeping a record of her previous groom details. My favorite part of the experience is how calm my pup seems in their care and how happy she is after I pick her up as if she had a great time. My pup is a little shy at first when I drop her off but everyone at Hot Dogs and Cool Cats makes her feel right at home. I highly recommend this groomer!

Had missed a previous appointment at a place I waited two weeks for! I called Hot Dogs & Cool cats to schedule and they happened to have a cancellation and was able to bring my Husky, Zion right in! Was greeted nicely, introduced to all the groomers and made feel very welcome! Love that they asked for vaccination records and any issues with the dog. They’re professional!! She was done and perfect in about 3 hours and isn’t the easiest dog to groom. She’s a drama queen!! Will keep coming back best she has looked and smelled! Great job on my Husky!

I've taken my puppy Jasper to them for a long time. They're very kind gentle and they know your name and the dog's name. When they come in the door they're greeted so well and he looks so good when he comes out. I really appreciate their service. I would recommend it to anyone.
Love these guys they always do such an amazing job. They're hard workers and I so appreciate them. They're so loving and sweet with the dogs. Love love love this place

We absolutely love this place for our little guy! Their prices are extremely competitive, they can always accommodate our schedule, but most of all, I get a good, happy vibe when I come in. My dog and I know that good people are taking care of him, and it’s a relief to know he’s in loving hands. They are experts in making our dog look like a little gentleman. You have a forever client with us! So grateful we found you!
We bring Meg (Bernedoodle) & Molly (Labradoodle) here and won't go anywhere else since finding them!
Amazing work
He always comes out so handsome.  He is always so happy to see the groomers.
First time here. My dog was groomed. These folks do a very good job. I'll take her back.

BEST GROOMER IN AZ! I have lived here now for 6 years and finally found the perfect place to bring my three fur babies! HD&CC are meticulous, friendly and affordable! My dogs have never looked better - Thank you Terry :)
My dogs and cat go here and I love them! Everyone is so friendly and the owner is so sweet and it’s nice not feeling worried about my animals at the groomers. They’re amazing!
They do great work! Maizie always looks so good when she is done!
I LOVE this place so much. They're all wonderful with Caduceus and Cali, and both of our dogs always come home well groomed, and well taken care of. I can't recommend Hot Dogs & Cool Cats enough.

Took our rescue here for her first bath and nail trim. We were worried due to her size and unknown history things may not go so well. Terri was paitent and did so great with our girl. She looks so beautiful. This will be our go to place moving forward.

What can I say about this place that hasn’t already been said? Their attention to detail is unparalleled, and their love and care for each animal is noticeable. They take pride in their work and are always ready to listen to a pet owner, whether it’s your first dog or fiftieth.

Bringing our dog here was definitely an upgrade from our previous dog groomer. I can definitely see why every Nextdoor, Reddit, and Facebook query for a pet groomer recommends this place. Frankly, I believe I would be remiss to take my dog elsewhere.

Their prices are more than reasonable and their location is conveniently accessible. For example, there is a streetlight not 100 yards from their storefront, something that is very important if you’re like me and don’t like making left turns in rush hour traffic.

I hope you pick this place to bring your furry friend to, not because I’m getting a kickback from a good review, but because I know how hard it can be to find a GOOD groomer. And these are GOOD groomers.
